title: Holomorphic scalar functions on the upper half-plane admit primitives
statement: Let H = {z ∈ ℂ | 0 < Im z}. For every function a : ℂ → ℂ that is complex differentiable on H, there exists A : ℂ → ℂ such that HasDerivAt A (a z) z for every z ∈ H. No regularity is required outside H.
lean_statement: ∀ (a : ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ a {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → ∃ A : ℂ → ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → HasDerivAt A (a z) z
